description: This file contains the implementation of a generic internal class 'StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>' which manages stream subscription handles within the Orleans streaming framework. It includes methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, resuming, delivering batches and items, and handling stream lifecycle events.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionHandleImpl<T>
classes.description: A concrete implementation of a stream subscription handle that manages subscription state, delivery, and lifecycle events for Orleans streams.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates the handle by nullifying internal references.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Returns the expected sequence token for stream delivery.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (observer)
methods.description: Resumes the subscription with a new observer.

methods.name: ResumeAsync (batch observer)
methods.description: Resumes the subscription with a batch observer.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of stream events, handling sequence tokens and rewindable streams.

methods.name: DeliverItem
methods.description: Delivers a single item to the observer, with type casting and sequence token validation.

methods.name: NextBatch
methods.description: Processes a batch container, delivering contained events.

methods.name: NextItem
methods.description: Delivers a single item to the observer asynchronously.

methods.name: NextItems
methods.description: Delivers multiple items to the batch observer.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signals stream completion to the observer.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error in the stream to the observer.

methods.name: SameStreamId
methods.description: Checks if the handle corresponds to a given stream ID.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on subscription ID.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns hash code based on subscription ID.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the handle.
